color_tokens._palette_intent: Warm-neutral cream surface (#FAF7F2) with Kohler-black text (#0A0A0A). Primary forest-green (#16332B) is the dark trade-trust accent per brief; navy (#1B2A38) is the secondary dark accent option. #EB0000 is the BelBes invariant — used statusно (live showroom-open indicator, urgent contractor-call accent), never as decorative chrome. No gradients, no neons.

typography._typography_intent: Brief explicitly forbids Inter and modern SaaS sans, requires trade serif wordmark in Cormorant/Domaine/Tiempos register. Domaine and Tiempos are commercial (license risk for Phase 1) — mapped to open-source Cormorant Garamond (display) which sits in the same heritage-serif register and is monogram-readable for a wordmark. Body is Source Serif 4 (Adobe → Google Fonts open-source) for editorial long-form readability. No mono — not a tech niche.

sections.intent: Set editorial trade-supply tone. Lead with main_message and primary CTA (Visit Showroom). Verifiable facts only: 1980, Oakland, Kohler & Grohe showroom.

Showroom-as-destination per niche-intel: 'come touch it' is the conversion. Two physical showrooms (Kohler Showroom + Bathroom Showroom) at 415 40th Street. Hours, address, photography of actual fixtures-as-design-objects (not catalog renders).
Three-generation, 46-years-on-the-same-block story as primary section, not buried About Us. Long-form serif headline; verifiable facts only — founded 1980, family-owned, East Bay block.

Address (415 40th Street, Oakland CA 94609), phone (510-652-7437), fax, hours (Mon–Fri 7:00–4:30, closed weekends), tertiary custom-request form. Map of Oakland location. No generic contact-form-as-default — phone and walk-in are the real channels.

arbiter_reasoning: Phase 1 Synthesizer (single, no trio). Started from MVP conservative vector (formality 0.85, density 0.4, decoration 0.05, energy 0.4, era_reference 60s-swiss-modernism, color_temperature neutral) and made two conscious adjustments justified by the brief: (1) era_reference 60s-swiss-modernism → 2024-editorial because brief.branding.typography_direction explicitly forbids modern SaaS sans and requires a trade serif wordmark in the Cormorant/Domaine/Tiempos register — Swiss-modernism is a sans-serif Helvetica register and would directly contradict the client direction; (2) color_temperature neutral → warm because brief.branding.preferred_palette_direction is explicit about a warm-neutral cream/off-white base with a deep navy or forest green dark accent. Other dimensions stay at conservative defaults — 46-year established trade business with phone-first contractor audience matches high formality, low decoration, restrained density, calm energy. Typography mapped from commercial Domaine/Tiempos (license risk for Phase 1) to open-source Cormorant Garamond (display) and Source Serif 4 (body), both in the same heritage-serif register and on Google Fonts. #EB0000 placed as accent (statusный role — live showroom-open indicator, urgent contractor-call moment) not primary, since brief explicitly forbids bright/neon palettes; primary forest-green (#16332B) carries the dark trade-trust load per brief. Sitemap merged brief's 6 required_sections into 5 (landing cap) by absorbing 'what_we_sell' into 'brands' as a brand-led product wall — conceptually unified since this client's offering is brand-defined specialty supply. composition left empty (Phase 1; COMP-002 prompt-assembly will populate when ≥12 components exist).
